script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Acceptance-20261102-r3'
$hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'candidate.zip') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if($hash -ne '6a2f2478e847ff06d6b7a35dbe01b543d2cd00ab52df7f96d2763d758e77782a'){throw 'Candidate hash mismatch'}
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'candidate.zip') -DestinationPath (Join-Path $d 'candidate')
$server='& ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText('''+(Join-Path $d 'fixture-server.ps1')+'''))) -TestDirectory '''+$d+''' -Port 18951'
$encoded=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($server))
$s=Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList '-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-EncodedCommand',$encoded -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
$profile=Join-Path $d 'edge-profile'
if(Test-Path $profile){throw 'Profile already exists'}
$e=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe' -ArgumentList ('--user-data-dir="'+$profile+'"'),'--remote-debugging-port=19332','--no-first-run','--no-default-browser-check','--new-window','--window-size=1150,800','edge://extensions/' -PassThru
@{fixturePID=$s.Id;browserPID=$e.Id;profile=$profile;debugPort=19332;candidateSHA256=$hash;manifestVersion=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $d 'candidate\manifest.json')|ConvertFrom-Json).version} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
